definition: לֶ֫תֶךְ noun [masculine] a barley-measure (Late Hebrew id. , a corn-measure); only in שְׂעֹרִים ׳ חֹמֶרשְֿׂעֹרִים וְל Hos 3:2 according to ᵑ9 = 1/2 כֹּר = 1/2 חֹמֶר (q. v.), compare Mishna ( Levy NHWB ii. 531 ), but this tradition is uncertain (compare Now Archaeology i. 203 ); ᵐ5 νέβελ οἴνου , for ׳ שׂ ׳ ל .
